name: google/boringssl
description: Google's OpenSSL fork powering Chrome/Chromium, Android, and other Google products with a focus on clean, maintainable code. Provides a QUIC API and is used in high-performance production environments.
score_rationale: Widely deployed TLS library with 2.1k stars and active 2026 releases, though explicitly not intended for general third-party use due to no API/ABI stability guarantees.
